summary: This Form 6-K filed by 707 Cayman Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: JEM) on July 21, 2026 attaches a notice and proxy card for an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for August 5, 2026. The filing does not disclose the specific resolution to be voted on, only mentioning an agenda item to increase authorized share capital. There is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, spin-off, rights offering, or other special-situation event. This is a routine foreign private issuer meeting notice with a capital increase proposal, constituting an ordinary corporate governance matter rather than a special situation. No deal terms, advisors, or premium are disclosed.
